newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct overseas ship orders fall 77.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct overseas ship orders fall 77.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Ship export contracts concluded by Japanese shipbuilders in October totalled 14 vessels, or 335,799 gross registered tons (grt), down 77.3 percent from the same period a year earlier, an industry body said on Tuesday.

"The fall in October export contracts was exaggerated as contracts in October 1995 were exceptionally high as the yen weakened against the dollar around that period," an official with the Japan Ship Exporters' Association said.
Orders for October comprised eight freighters and six bulk carriers. No orders for tankers were received.
From April to October, Japan received ship export orders for 130 vessels, or 4.15 million grt, the association said.
